title: Stale pnpm shim wins PATH order
summary: A stale pnpm forwarding shim shadows the repository-approved pnpm launcher while both are already present in the isolated fixture.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-PATH-002 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: The stale pnpm launcher's Node entry target no longer exists, so the resolved command fails with a genuine missing-module error before any fixture assertion can run.
planned_setup: Create stale and approved pnpm-compatible forwarding launchers with the same declared manager identity.
Remove the stale launcher's absolute Node entry target from its tree.
Place the stale launcher first in PATH.
Do not execute a shell profile.
